mapper.sql: SELECT * FROM emp01_person INNER JOIN emp03_trans ON ( emp03_person_id = emp01_person_id AND emp03_trans_date = (SELECT MAX(emp03_trans_date) FROM emp03_trans WHERE emp03_person_id = emp01_person_id AND emp03_trans_date <= f_today()) ) WHERE emp01_company_id = #{companyId} AND emp03_trans_cd NOT IN ('900') /*(800:겸직/900:퇴직)*/ AND COALESCE(emp03_non_stay_yn,'false') != 'true'
mapper.select: SELECT sch07_alarm_record_id AS alarm_record_id , sch07_company_id AS company_id , sch07_person_id AS person_id , sch07_alarm_message AS alarm_message FROM sch07_alarm_record WHERE sch07_alarm_type = #{alarmType} AND sch07_alarm_date_time >= f_sysdate() + interval '-1day' AND sch07_send_date_time IS NULL

SELECT sys01_company_id AS company_id , sys01_loc_nm AS loc_name FROM sys01_company WHERE 1=1 AND UPPER(CONCAT(sys01_company_nm,sys01_loc_nm,sys01_erp_product_cd,sys01_note)) LIKE UPPER('%') AND ( ('true' = 'true' AND COALESCE(sys01_use_yn,'true') = 'true' ) OR ('true' = 'false') ) ORDER BY sys01_company_id
SELECT sys01_loc_nm FROM sys01_company WHERE sys01_company_id = #{companyId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flt10_tr INNER JOIN sys12_calendar ON sys12_company_id = flt10_company_id WHERE COALESCE(sys12_working_yn, 'false') = 'true' AND TO_CHAR(sys12_day, 'yyyyMMdd') = TO_CHAR(f_sysdate(), 'yyyyMMdd') AND flt10_company_id = #{companyId} AND COALESCE(flt10_status_cd, '00') = '10' AND flt10_company_id != 83211 /*demo제외*/

SELECT emp01_person.emp01_person_id AS person_id , emp01_person.emp01_mobile_telno AS mobile_telno , emp01_person.emp01_email_addr AS email_address , (to_decrypts(emp01_password) IS NOT NULL) AS has_password FROM emp01_person INNER JOIN emp03_trans ON ( emp03_person_id = emp01_person_id AND emp03_trans_date = ( SELECT MAX(a.emp03_trans_date) FROM emp03_trans a WHERE a.emp03_person_id = emp01_person_id AND a.emp03_trans_date <= f_sysdate() ) ) INNER JOIN emp93_sms_notice_target ON emp93_person_id = emp01_person_id WHERE emp01_company_id = #{companyId} AND emp93_sms_notice_cd = #{noticeCode} AND emp93_company_id = #{companyId} AND emp03_trans_cd NOT IN ('900') AND emp01_person_id NOT IN ( SELECT emp04_add_person_id FROM emp04_add_title WHERE emp04_person_id IN ( SELECT emp03_person_id FROM emp03_trans WHERE emp03_trans_cd = '900' ) ) AND emp01_mobile_telno IS NOT NULL

SELECT apr07_alt_appr.apr07_target_emp_id AS target_emp_id , tgt.emp01_mobile_telno AS mobile_telno , tgt.emp01_email_addr AS email_address , (to_decrypts(tgt.emp01_password) IS NOT NULL) AS has_password FROM apr07_alt_appr INNER JOIN emp01_person tgt ON tgt.emp01_person_id = apr07_target_emp_id WHERE apr07_target_emp_id = #{empId} AND ( (f_sysdate() <= apr07_start_date ) OR (f_sysdate() <= apr07_close_date ) OR (f_sysdate() BETWEEN apr07_start_date AND apr07_close_date) ) AND emp01_mobile_telno IS NOT NULL

SELECT pay50_confirmer_id AS confirmer_id , count(*) AS request_cnt FROM pay50_expense WHERE pay50_company_id = #{companyId} AND pay50_confirm_status_cd = '10' /*(10:신청)*/ AND pay50_confirmer_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY pay50_confirmer_id
